## 三个代表项目 / Featured Projects

- **考亭古街 / Kaoting Ancient Street**：别人困在细节里，我换个方向签下 212 万。负责文旅售前策划，把项目重新定位成“当地文旅的源头”；客户认可，最后签下 212 万合同。 / Led pre-sales strategic planning, repositioned the destination as the cultural fountainhead of the region, and secured a ¥2.12M contract.
- **数字月台 / Digital Loading Dock**：不写 PPT，直接进场联调，真机上线。在车间把 PLC 和移动机器人接起来，用统一状态逻辑管理设备动作；真机联调，上线通过验收。 / Bridged PLCs with mobile robots on the factory floor, orchestrated actions with a unified state machine, and passed final acceptance on live hardware.
- **EmergentInc**：让 AI 不再只是聊天，而是自动赚钱。AI 自己跑任务、自己改自己、自动去赚钱；代码全部开源，拿来就能跑。 / Autonomous agents execute workflows, evolve their own code, and generate economic value. 100% open-source and ready to deploy out of the box.
